name: @mailbowox/core-native
description: UniFFI bindings for the mailbowox core

scripts.ubrn:web: ubrn build wasm2 --config ubrn.config.yaml --profile wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --skip-pass=inlining-optimizing --skip-pass=memory-packing src/generated-web/mailbowox_core.wasm -o src/generated-web/mailbowox_core.wasm
scripts.ubrn:clean: rm -rf cpp android ios src/generated src/generated-web src/index.tsx src/NativeCoreNative.ts build *.podspec

author: Erwan Leboucher
